description: Three captured leads remain unresolved: S005 is an announcement of a planned 14 February Sarajevo teachers' protest (execution/turnout unverified); S007 is a Klix Tuzla budget-users headline with date/turnout/target unverified; S008 is a FoNet headline about citizens at a Mostar interchange with event identity and demands unverified.
